title: Chicken Casserole Italiano
description: A hearty and flavorful Italian-inspired casserole featuring chicken, nutty pesto sauce, and German sausage.
instructions: Cook the German sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned and cooked through.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Stir in the nutty pesto sauce and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with casserole.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
